title: Adopt API Gateway for External Partner Integration
narrative: FEDC currently exposes operational and customer data to external partners — meter manufacturers, third-party billing agents, and regulatory bodies — through a collection of point-to-point integrations. Each integration has been built independently, with inconsistent authentication approaches, no centralised rate limiting, and no unified audit trail. This has created a growing security and operational risk as the partner ecosystem has expanded. We propose adopting a managed API gateway as the single entry point for all external API traffic. The gateway will enforce OAuth 2.0 authentication, apply rate limiting and quota policies, provide a developer portal for partner onboarding, and centralise API telemetry for monitoring and incident response. All existing point-to-point partner connections will be migrated through the gateway within 12 months of adoption.

requirements.title: Single external entry point
requirements.description: All API calls from external partners must be routed through the API gateway. Direct connections to internal services from external parties are not permitted.

requirements.title: Authentication enforcement
requirements.description: The gateway must enforce OAuth 2.0 with client credentials flow for all external API consumers. API key authentication is not permitted for new integrations.

requirements.title: Availability
requirements.description: The gateway must maintain 99.9% availability and respond to API requests within 200ms at the 95th percentile under normal operating load.
